rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name/ZIP and viewed relevant orders, but then performed order-changing writes without clear prior user confirmation (modified items on #W3730488 and #W9810810, and attempted an address change). They also selected a payment method (gift_card_7252880) for modifications without explicit approval. The shipping address change for the laptop was not successfully completed; the agent ultimately escalated to a human after item modification left the order not fully pending. Given the policy requires confirmation before any write and successful completion or proper handoff before changes, the interaction did not meet the pass bar.
